svg.font-family: Segoe UI Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.title: Import model dialog, several files selected (dark theme)
svg.desc: The Import model dialog with all three files selected. The name row is absent and the content folder reads Mixed. The settings panel, drawn with the editor's shared property editors, edits the three files: Up axis applies to FBX files only (its qualifier says so); Normals is set on all three (full override bar, reset); the smoothing angle, a NumberField in degrees, differs between files and reads Mixed with a half override bar; Materials asks to select one file. An error InfoBar says Crates.gltf's name is taken, with Replace as its action. The facts InfoBar, an error bar titled 1 error, 3 warnings, says 3 files selected; the Before import flyout is open under its action button: DiagnosticCards without icons grouped under Car.fbx and Crates.gltf, each naming the objects it is about, with a chevron that lists them all; Truck.glb has no findings and is left out. Light dismiss: Esc or a click outside closes it. Import 3 is disabled. Colours are WinUI 3 dark-theme tokens.
svg.text: 3 files · each is analysed before it is imported, without loading its buffers · they import as one run
